_comment: Fictional email MCP server fixture for KCH-7 eval gold set.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email message to one or more recipients via SMTP protocol.

tools.name: read_inbox
tools.description: Read and retrieve messages from the email inbox, including private personal communications.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Retrieve personal contact details including phone numbers, email addresses, and private identity information for a given contact.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a new draft email message with subject and body text.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search and query email messages by subject, sender, or content keywords.

tools.name: delete_email
tools.description: Delete or remove an email message from the mailbox.

tools.name: forward_email
tools.description: Forward an email thread to new recipients, relaying the message and private attachments to external parties.
